talkingPoints.text: smooth with a soft blur effect

benefits.text: Nu Blur Tint matte cream lip gives a smooth matte, soft and moist lip effect with no dry feel on the lips. Silk Air-Fit Pigments technology helps the color go on thin and even, without clumping, and helps minimize the look of lip lines. The formula can be built up in multiple layers to adjust intensity as desired.

howToUse.text: Use the slim, tapered applicator to apply evenly along the lips. Can be lightly blended with a fingertip for a natural blur effect. Can be used as a soft blur blush.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.

positioning.text: Mini tint with a smooth matte blur effect, compact and easy to carry, helping complete naturally soft, blurred lips with a single press of the lips.

texture.text: Smooth, lightweight cream tint with a soft blur.

claimDisclaimers.text: The mini size is a compact version of Nu Blur Tint; do not interpret it as a new formula if the documentation only states same quality/better portability. “No dry feel on the lips” should not be interpreted as nourishing or treating dry lips. If using a BEST shade from the chart, do not call it a best-seller without sales data.
